name: outlook-multi-mailbox
description: Search and manage Outlook mail across explicitly allowed mailboxes

interface.shortDescription: Search and manage allowed Outlook mail
interface.longDescription: Search, investigate documents, inspect attachment evidence, and read messages across an explicitly allowed set of Microsoft Outlook mailboxes through twelve bounded, read-only MCP tools by default. Two local attachment-handoff tools are available only with the independent `PLUGIN_ALLOW_LOCAL_HANDOFFS` opt-in; they return opaque integrity metadata, never content or local paths. Five additional mailbox-write tools — move, copy, mark read/unread, download attachments, and create drafts — are available only when explicitly enabled in configuration (`allowWrites`). A single send tool is available only with the independent `PLUGIN_ALLOW_SEND` opt-in, which refuses to start unless a sending mailbox is pinned by configuration and covered by the outbound sender allowlist; the sending mailbox is never chosen per call, though recipients, subject, and body are. Enabling that gate means enabling outbound email. Deleting messages remains impossible by construction: no tool in this plugin exposes it.
defaultPrompt: Find a message across my allowed mailboxes
